item.title: The bug where VS Code's Debug Console was pasting 'repl:1' into my clipboard
item.author: yogeshwaran.chandrakasan@gmail.com (Yogeshwaran Chandrakasan)
item.description: A 2-line CSS fix in VS Code that taught me how user-select: text cascades through every descendant — even the decorative ones. The fix for my own misread of the bug: stop looking at JavaScript, start looking at the cascade.
